shelters.name: Cheyenne Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Founded over 50 years ago. Largest community-centered animal shelter in Wyoming serving Cheyenne and Laramie County. For half a century ensuring homeless pets have safe place.

shelters.name: Casper Humane Society
shelters.description: No-kill animal shelter providing shelter, medical care and quality homes. Mission to find forever homes, encourage neutering, prevent cruelty, and provide humane education.

shelters.name: Animal Adoption Center
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit supporting rescue and adoption programs, educational initiatives, and spay/neuter programs in Jackson Hole.

shelters.name: Jackson-Teton County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Unit under Jackson Police Department. Annually 200 dogs pass through with 75% reclaimed. Nearly 90% of 110+ cats find new homes.

shelters.name: Black Dog Animal Rescue
shelters.description: No-kill verified shelter welcoming dogs of all colors, ages, sizes, breeds, and cats too.

shelters.name: Laramie Animal Welfare Society
shelters.description: Provides foster training, oversees feral cat colonies through TNR programs. Ensures cats receive spaying/neutering and vaccinations.

shelters.name: Sheridan Dog & Cat Shelter
shelters.description: Animal shelter serving Sheridan and northern Wyoming.

shelters.name: Western Fremont County Humane Society
shelters.description: Over 25 years rescuing and placing mistreated or abandoned dogs, cats and horses in Dubois and Crowheart communities.

shelters.name: Red Desert Humane Society
shelters.description: Humane society serving Sweetwater County and southwestern Wyoming.

shelters.name: Laramie Peak Humane Society
shelters.description: Protects, cares for, and provides humane disposition of unwanted or stray animals. Offers impound services, TNR, and adoption drives.

shelters.name: Dog Is My Copilot
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) organization transporting animals from overcrowded shelters to adoption centers where loving families are waiting.

shelters.name: St. Francis Animal Shelter
shelters.description: No-kill verified shelter serving Buffalo and Johnson County.

shelters.name: Lucky's Place
shelters.description: Private, independent no-kill shelter providing safe environment for lost, abandoned, and homeless animals of Star Valley.

shelters.name: Second Chance Sheridan Cat Rescue
shelters.description: Cat rescue organization serving Sheridan and northern Wyoming.

shelters.name: PAWS - Providing Animal Welfare Services
shelters.description: Shelters pets, supports owners, prevents homelessness, promotes responsible ownership, and protects animals during crises in Teton County.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Wyoming animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Cheyenne Animal Shelter (50+ years) is the largest in the state. Dog Is My Copilot transports animals from overcrowded shelters nationwide. Western Fremont County Humane Society has 25+ years of service. Coverage spans Cheyenne, Casper, Jackson, Sheridan, Rock Springs, and rural areas.
